game.title: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham
game.blurb: Family action-adventure from TT Games and Traveller's Tales (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and Warner Bros. Interactive), released 2014-11-10. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Family. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0), five story levels at a time, plus chapters drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Pursuers in the Sewers to The Big Grapple
chapters.summary: Story levels 1 to 5: Pursuers in the Sewers, Breaking BATS!, Space suits you, Sir!, Space Station Infestation and The Big Grapple.

chapters.title: The Lantern Menace to A Blue Hope
chapters.summary: Story levels 6 to 10: The Lantern Menace, Europe Against It, Big Trouble in Little Gotham, Power of Love and A Blue Hope. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Jailhouse Nok to the Bonus Level
chapters.summary: Story levels 11 to 15: Jailhouse Nok, All the Rage, Need for Greed, Aw-Qward Situation and Breaking the Ice, then the bonus level Same Bat-time! Same Bat-channel! Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Hubs, Secrets and 100%
chapters.summary: The Watchtower, Batcave, Hall of Justice, Moon and Lantern planet hubs: hub races, hidden doughnuts, Riddler trophies, the celebrity party, Red Brick extras and the 100% stud fountain.

chapters.title: Characters, Free Play and Feats
chapters.summary: True Hero status, character transformations, Free Play pairs, custom characters, gliding and bouncing.

chapters.title: DLC: Man of Steel, Batman 75th Anniversary and Dark Knight Trilogy
chapters.summary: The three DLC levels with their Minikits, True Hero runs, Free Play pairs and special feats.

chapters.title: DLC: Arrow, The Squad and Bizarro
chapters.summary: The three DLC levels with their Minikits, True Hero runs, Free Play pairs and special feats.

Fandom (lego.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://lego.fandom.com/wiki/LEGO_Batman_3:_Beyond_Gotham
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki has the guide under "LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham" at completion stage 3. All 15 story level pages and the bonus level page are written (about 9,600 to 14,700 characters each), as are the hub pages Watchtower, Batcave, Hall of Justice, Moon, Oa, Zamaron, Odym and Nok (Ysmault is short, about 600 characters), Characters, Vehicles, Extras, Cheat Codes, VR Missions, Achievements and trophies, and the DLC page with its six level pages (Man of Steel, Batman 75th Anniversary, Dark Knight Trilogy, Arrow, The Squad, Bizarro): 40 subpages in all. The Walkthrough index, Gameplay, Okaara and Qward pages are linked from its contents but not written. The three story chapters follow its contents order, five levels each; the level names also appear in the Steam achievement descriptions. Titles are reworded from page names and no text was copied. RAWG keeps DLC entries for Rainbow Batman, Arrow, Batman 75th Anniversary and Bizarro separately; Steam app 313690 holds the achievements for all six DLC levels named above (their API names contain "DLC"), so they get two chapters of three. The Free Play pair for Batman (Sinestro Corps) and Vampire Batman, and the Arrow, Squad and Bizarro feats that do not name their level, were placed by API name (for example ACHIEVEMENT_DLC_BATMAN75_..., ACHIEVEMENT_DLC_SQUAD_...). lego.fandom.com answers the API under "LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham" with about 273 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 70 Steam achievements is hidden.
